ChangeLog:
V7.7 Changelog

-> Added Prebuilt Configurations to the regular and slot configuration sections.
-> Added Damage Indicator in Visuals page, World ESP section.
-> Added Free Rotation in Misc page.
-> Added Anti Grounded Capsule in Misc page.
-> Added Only Combat Target option for Players Health Bar and Ki Players ESP.
-> Auto Healing Chamber will not use the chamber if anything healed you like Auto Senzu while traveling to it.
-> Anti Knockback now removes movement restrictions if your exec is supported, except, purposely made like that, when you are ragdolled.
-> Ki Players ESP now shows remaining God Ki and renders closer to the player's head.
-> Updated Player ESP Visuals to match the script better and not look like a FPS game ESP.
-> Anti Admin on Server Hop mode now sends you to lobby then it presses Play if you were in a Raid/Dungeon (put script in autoexec and configuration on autoload).
-> Stat Checker is now more reliable against any target (no more errors in some NPCs e.g Frieza).
-> Teleport dropdowns such as NPCs Teleports now get their values auto deselected.
-> Fixed No Slow conflicting with a few features and it isn't destructive to a specific part of the game client anymore.
-> Fixed Tag Spoof being able to conflict with a few features.
-> Fixed Anti Legit Miss affecting Auto Dungeon and Auto Raid.
-> Fixed No Form Charge sometimes making certain abilities like Regeneration and Reform not usable.
-> Fixed Auto Quest not completing the Find Namekian Spaceship quest.
-> Fixed a bug in TeleSpeed where it would stay enabled no matter what even if you disabled the toggle if you changed the slider value while using TeleSpeed (Pressing Q or trigger key and move).
-> Fixed disabling Players ESP with ESP Name Tags enabled not restoring player names above their head.
-> Fixed some bugs with Android Fast Fly Ki Regen, especially for execs with lower sunc.
-> Fixed Dragon Balls ESP not rendering Namek Dragon Balls and Stealable Balls at further distances.
-> Fixed other minor bugs.
